p.span: FP<IntT, OneV> - a fixed-point type represented by an integer of type IntT and with value 1.0 being represented by OneV. The value of unity does not need to be an integer.
v15 uses QAT: FT OneV = 256 (max 255), hidden OneV = 128 (max 127), affine scales 128 / 64 / 128, and int64 final rescaling.

span.span: For each piece-to-piece attacks on the board, activate features indexed by that attacking piece, the attacked piece, and the square of both pieces. For each
piece on the board, with locations adjusted for given perspective (flip), activate feature indexed by the following tuple

div.style: font-size: 6px;

div.div: 1. KSqH[32] - our king's square mapped (mirrored) to half of the board such that A1 == H1

div.style: font-size: 6px;

div.div: 2. PcSq[64] - square the piece is on

div.style: font-size: 6px;

div.div: 3. PcK[11] - essentially piece.type * 2 + piece.is_our; map kings to single index

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe center; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 218px; height: 1px; padding-top: 90px; margin-left: 14px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: left; color: #000000;
display: inline-block; font-size: 6px; font-family: 'Courier New'; color: #000000; line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;
div.div: For each (non-king) piece-to-(non-king) piece attack on the board, activate a feature indexed by the attacking piece, the attacked piece, and the square of both pieces.
Also, activate a feature for each pair of opposing pawns on adjacent ranks of the same file, indexed by their two squares.

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe center; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 218px; height: 1px; padding-top: 90px; margin-left: 244px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: left; color: #000000;
display: inline-block; font-size: 6px; font-family: 'Courier New'; color: #000000; line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;
div.div: For each piece on the board, with locations adjusted for the given perspective (flip), activate a feature indexed by:
1. KSqH[32] - our king's square mapped (mirrored) to half of the board such that A1 == H1
2. PcSq[64] - square the piece is on
3. PcK[11] - essentially piece.type * 2 + piece.is_our; map kings to single index
